svg.aria-label: Architecture: an offline ingestion pipeline turns the raw dataset into committed files; pnpm seed loads them into four typed Postgres tables; a Claude agent answers broker questions through five typed database tools behind a sanitizing route; a local eval harness measures the agent against the same database.
svg.title: Freight Carrier Agent — system overview

g.text: read 1 → 2 → 3: ingest once, offline · store typed · answer at request time
scripts/ — runs locally once; outputs committed
reads raw text only — the pre-labeled
decoy fields never enter the prompt
MC exact → email exact → fuzzy name;
(the only place the decoys are read)
are the database + Anthropic API only
Why typed columns: 38 of 55 calls are unfindable
by full-text search on their own MC number —
extracted_* + resolution close that hole exactly.
pnpm seed — parse + validate everything first,
then wipe + reload in one transaction;
src/db/schema.ts — 4 tables via Drizzle · local Postgres.app, Neon in prod · every query parameterized
roles + plain text only; client-sent tool
results are dropped, so a forged "fact"
can never reach the model as grounded
tool loop, max 6 steps; every number cites [source id]
compliance gate · abstains when tools return no data
5 tools — typed, narrow, no LLM inside
get_load · one load by exact 8-digit id
keyed by MC or company name; vs REFERENCE_DATE
market_rate · pure SQL aggregate, never estimates
compliance gate + rate/schedule validation in code;
Eval harness — pnpm eval · local sidecar (CI runs the offline meta-tests only)
24 cases in 4 buckets (factual · set-retrieval · email-draft · abstention) × k=3 runs each
8 pure-code graders + a calibrated LLM judge for only the 2 draft checks code can't express
Wilson intervals · pass@1 and pass^3 · before/after table re-run after every change
same DB, same tools, same prompt as production — gold and inputs cannot drift apart
same agent loop as the route
gold re-derived from this DB (SQL recorded per case)
